name: Barbarian audit: Time To Kill! spell modifier reaches its target spells (#3697)
contract: Audit report #3697 asked for a script for a passive whose effects are native spell-mod auras (107 flat, 108 percent). The effect BasePoints and EffectSpellClassMask in Spell.dbc name the spell-mod operation, amount and affected Barbarian spells; Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must deliver base+flat or base*(100+pct)/100. Expected values are computed from the DBC amount, not from the implementation.

steps.label: before: 800401 has no modifier for op 3
926591 op 3 flat +1 reaches 800401 (mask selects 1 Barbarian spell(s))
